corrections.reason: The attached claims describe US repo agreements and US Treasury collateral without stating currency denomination; the source article does not characterise repo as dollar funding.

corrections.original_text: US funding and Treasury-market activity have become highly concentrated in specific channels and times
corrections.corrected_text: US repo funding sits in a few channels, and Treasury trading has clustered around the close
corrections.reason: The evidence gives current repo collateral, maturity and clearing shares but no time series showing rising concentration in funding channels. 'Have become highly concentrated' presupposes a prior, less concentrated state that the claims do not support. The clustering of Treasury trading over time is supported and is retained.

corrections.original_text: around the 4 p.m. fixed-income index pricing time.
corrections.reason: The volume figures are supported, but the attached claims do not establish that 4 p.m. is the fixed-income index pricing time. The source article does state this; the extracted claims do not carry it, so the briefing's own evidence trail cannot support the description.

corrections.reason: The claim establishes the scorecard's existence and coverage but not its purpose. The source states a different purpose again — identifying which fast-ageing economies face greater difficulty easing demographic pressure through automation.

corrections.original_text: Financial-market adjustments could have substantial, uneven cross-border effects because global positions are more exposed to valuation changes.
corrections.corrected_text: Countries have leaned on rising asset values to support growth, which leaves them more exposed if markets correct.
corrections.reason: Faithful to the same claim but rewritten in plain English, as the interpretation brief requires. The original stacked three abstractions in the most prominent text on the page.

corrections.original_text: Funding and trading are increasingly concentrated.

corrections.reason: 'Increasingly concentrated' carries the same unsupported presupposition corrected in the theme 1 title. BBB's read is not covered by the automated verifier, so this was found in human review.
